## Server

### Fixed

- Fixed melee attacks failing to damage players on servers without a host character. The server now initializes the game's spell definitions before combat begins.
- The game's normal damage, targeting, and friendly-fire rules remain in effect.

## Client

No client gameplay change. Existing 0.3.6 clients can join updated servers.
